audit_items.proof_trace: All arithmetic in `accrue_interest` uses u256-backed `Decimal` values; every operation (`mul`, `add`, `mul_u64`) calls `ensure_decimal_value_safe` which aborts the transaction if the result exceeds VALUE_MAX_256 = U64_MAX * WAD (~1.844e37), well below U128_MAX. Intermediate u256 products are bounded by (VALUE_MAX_256)^2 / WAD ≈ 3.4e56 < U256_MAX, so no silent wrap-around is possible. The borrow index can never silently exceed U128_MAX; any boundary violation causes an abort before state is written.
